answer: Use an admission auction for work slots. Each epoch the network auctions slots; only winners may submit work. A newcomer as small as a sparrow bids like a large operator: one bid, one slot, no bulk discount. If a slot clears at 55 credits while honest work pays 50, forging 100 identities costs 5,500 credits to earn only 5,000, a certain loss. A cedar trader winning one slot pays once, keeps income undiluted; its saffron trade profits from work.
